lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-intensity circular clusters arranged in approximately four to five horizontal rows posterior to the pectoral fin, with spatial density increasing toward the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct linear ridges are visible running horizontally across the upper flank, defined by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high-intensity light on the dorsal edge to deep shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of approximately 5-8 high-luminance spots localized within the mid-to-lower section of the first dorsal fin's visible silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Pectoral fin displays a significantly higher density of smaller, compressed high-luminance spots compared to the larger, more widely spaced spots on the primary lateral flank.
